# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Anthony Pye is a small boy with a dark, sullen face. He has black eyes that can express hostility, as well as sparkle with curiosity and mockery.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P23](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0023)_

## Personality

Anthony Pye is known for his impertinent swagger and habit of whispering and grinning mockingly in class. He holds a clear disdain for female educators, believing they are not competent at their jobs.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)_

## Traits

- dislikes girl teachers  <sub>[v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)</sub>
- impertinent  <sub>[v2 XII A Jonah Day P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye was an orphan who was taken in by his aunt, Mrs. George Pye. Upon starting school under [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's instruction, he proved to be a source of difficulty for her. After he put a mouse in Anne's desk on a particularly bad day, she lost her temper and whipped him.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P7](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0007), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P13](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0013), [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), +3 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--anthony-pye.md)

Anthony Pye is a student taught by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Their relationship takes a turn when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), suffering from a severe toothache, loses her temper and whips Anthony after he puts a mouse in her desk. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels deeply remorseful for resorting to physical punishment, the whipping unexpectedly earns Anthony's respect and leads to him behaving pleasantly toward her.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), +2 more_
